in_marathi.name: Tikeshwar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Wisdom
in_marathi.long_meaning: Tikeshwar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Lord Tikeshwar is the god of wisdom and knowledge. He is also known as Tirreth or Tirrthankar. He is often depicted as a wise and contemplative figure, with a third eye symbolizing inner knowledge and insight.
